name: [🎃] Airport Security (Anomaly) ✈️
desc:
You've been hired as airport security for the night shift. Check passengers in, X-ray their bags and scan their bodies before they board.

But some passengers aren't human. Let one through and it won't board the plane... it will hunt you.

How to Play:
📸 Check their ID and photo
🧳 X-ray luggage and search for contraband
🦴 Body scan for missing limbs and wrong skeletons
📹 Watch the cameras for what your eyes miss
🔍 Interrogate suspects with a lie detector, brain scan, eye exam or fingerprint test
🚫 Deny anyone who seems off... but don't send away the innocent

👥 Play solo or with up to 4 friends
⚡ Tase your coworkers (or the monsters)
✈️ Endless shifts with burning emergency landings, ghosts, lockdowns and a serial killer who remembers how you treated him
😰 No health bar. Get too scared and you crash out.

⚠️ Contains jumpscares and loud sounds
🎧 Headphones recommended

❓ Can you spot the anomaly before it spots you?

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for more updates!

llm.loop: night shift airport security -> check IDs, X-ray bags, body scan -> deny non-human passengers -> survive what you let through
llm.objectives: spot anomalies before they hunt you
llm.instructions: check ID, X-ray, body scan, interrogate, deny suspicious
unique: Papers-Please style inspection with horror anomalies and many scan tools
